title: Infernux v0.4.3-v2 · Hotfix 2: Native Text and Plugin Foundations
codename: Hotfix 2: Native Text and Plugin Foundations
summary: This 0.4.3 hotfix adds reusable native text-animation and plugin-update interfaces, and repairs clocks and rendering state found during cross-platform validation. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; the engine uses build 2, with the separate Hub update at 0.4.3-3.

items.title: Update installed engines to a newer wheel hotfix directly from their cards, with a background catalog refresh. Older cached wheels and project version pins remain unchanged by the download.
items.text: Update installed engines to a newer wheel hotfix directly from their cards, with a background catalog refresh. Older cached wheels and project version pins remain unchanged by the download.

items.title: Separate explicit project hotfix updates from engine version upgrades. Choose an installed release; Hub prepares its exact engine and Python runtime on the next launch. Open projects cannot be switched, and the version change preserves project assets.
items.text: Separate explicit project hotfix updates from engine version upgrades. Choose an installed release; Hub prepares its exact engine and Python runtime on the next launch. Open projects cannot be switched, and the version change preserves project assets.

items.title: Preserve the real unscaled frame duration and clamp scaled simulation consistently. Fix packaged Players treating the native pause method as a Boolean, which stopped Python clocks and time-driven effects.
items.text: Preserve the real unscaled frame duration and clamp scaled simulation consistently. Fix packaged Players treating the native pause method as a Boolean, which stopped Python clocks and time-driven effects.

items.title: Provide removable Normal, Late, Fixed and Editor update registrations, with plugin ownership and automatic cleanup.
items.text: Provide removable Normal, Late, Fixed and Editor update registrations, with plugin ownership and automatic cleanup.

items.title: Expose read-only grapheme, glyph, word and line layouts with original UTF-8 source ranges. Compose canonical combining accents during layout and correct whitespace wrapping.
items.text: Expose read-only grapheme, glyph, word and line layouts with original UTF-8 source ranges. Compose canonical combining accents during layout and correct whitespace wrapping.

items.title: Add reusable character buffers for offsets, rotation, scale, skew, four-corner deformation and color, plus visible-character control and separate manual, effects and appearance layers.
items.text: Add reusable character buffers for offsets, rotation, scale, skew, four-corner deformation and color, plus visible-character control and separate manual, effects and appearance layers.

items.title: Support basic rich-text color, size and line-break spans; preserve clipping, group opacity, font atlases and material boundaries in screen and world UI.
items.text: Support basic rich-text color, size and line-break spans; preserve clipping, group opacity, font atlases and material boundaries in screen and world UI.

items.title: Invalidate camera state when replacing render graphs. Publish Web font atlases before recording UI geometry, fixing missing world text when animated screen text loads additional fonts.
items.text: Invalidate camera state when replacing render graphs. Publish Web font atlases before recording UI geometry, fixing missing world text when animated screen text loads additional fonts.

items.title: Add reversible editor preview scopes. Saving, entering Play, closing a panel, deleting a target, undoing changes or unloading a plugin restores captured values; saving a clean document also ends its preview.
items.text: Add reversible editor preview scopes. Saving, entering Play, closing a panel, deleting a target, undoing changes or unloading a plugin restores captured values; saving a clean document also ends its preview.

items.title: Prepare the official catalog for independently maintained animation plugins without adding their source repositories to the engine's submodules or build dependencies. Publish package files before the complete catalog.
items.text: Prepare the official catalog for independently maintained animation plugins without adding their source repositories to the engine's submodules or build dependencies. Publish package files before the complete catalog.

items.title: Retain the engine and Unicode notices in desktop, Android and Web Player distributions.
items.text: Retain the engine and Unicode notices in desktop, Android and Web Player distributions.

items.title: Preserve each published hotfix's actual release tag in website history, keeping the original base release record.
items.text: Preserve each published hotfix's actual release tag in website history, keeping the original base release record.
